description: Refusal stop_reason neutralized at the constant level: the pooled "refusal" comparison constant in the refusal-handler module is renamed (7->7 chars), so the stop_reason==="refusal" check never fires — refusal telemetry and refusal-message conversion are skipped and the turn continues. 2.1.228 is bytecode-only; the old BeK() JS early-return surface is gone.

patches.description: Rename the pooled "refusal" stop_reason constant in the refusal-handler module so stop_reason==="refusal" never matches and the turn continues silently

note: 7 copies of the bare length-prefixed constant exist dump-wide; the anchor (pad byte + kind-2 separator record) uniquely selects the refusal-cluster copy at ~29360536.
